meta.name: code-ts
meta.description: TypeScript code shape inside a well-named module — taste, not lint. Prefer one class or namespace per file (the unit a test targets) over scattered free exports; consolidate related code, don't fragment. The unit of code should be the unit of spec. Use when authoring TS in `editor/grida-canvas*`, `editor/lib/`, or `packages/*`. Sibling to the `naming` skill; React-specific shape lives in `code-react`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按模块组织 TypeScript 代码，提升可测试性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望 TypeScript 代码按模块组织、每个文件对应一个测试单元
copy.tagline_en: Organize TypeScript code into well-named modules for testability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want TypeScript code organized into modules with one class or namespace per file

howto.what: Claude 会按照“一个文件一个类或命名空间”的规则组织 TypeScript 代码，把相关功能合并到一个模块里，而不是分散成多个小文件。测试文件会直接对应模块的公开接口。
howto.when: 当你在 `editor/grida-canvas*`、`editor/lib/` 或 `packages/*` 目录下编写 TypeScript 代码时触发。

say.text: 帮我重构这个文件，把五个独立函数合并成一个命名空间。
say.note: Claude 会按规则合并代码。

say.text: 为这个模块创建对应的测试文件。
say.note: Claude 会生成与模块接口对应的测试。

howto.what_en: Claude organizes TypeScript code with one class or namespace per file, consolidating related functionality into a single module instead of scattering across many files. Tests directly mirror the module's public interface.
howto.when_en: Triggered when authoring TypeScript in `editor/grida-canvas*`, `editor/lib/`, or `packages/*` directories.

say_en.text: Refactor this file to merge five standalone functions into one namespace.
Create a test file for this module.
say_en.note: Claude will generate tests matching the module's interface.
